subject.title: [Bug]: Zod-generated unanchored regex patterns break llama.cpp tool calling

question: Should OpenClaw treat llama.cpp regex handling as an operator-declared custom-provider compatibility setting, or ship a maintained llama.cpp-specific schema-normalization profile after live verification?
rationale: The repository already supports endpoint-specific schema cleanup, but choosing a built-in llama.cpp profile would create an ongoing provider contract and needs evidence across supported llama.cpp versions.

options.title: Validate the existing compatibility seam
options.body: Reproduce against the reported llama.cpp build and document the verified custom-provider normalization if it restores structured calls without weakening other schemas.

options.title: Add a maintained llama.cpp profile
options.body: Ship an endpoint-specific profile only after live tests establish a stable upstream grammar contract and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Validate the existing compatibility seam
recommendation.body: Reproduce against the reported llama.cpp build and document the verified custom-provider normalization if it restores structured calls without weakening other schemas.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent llama.cpp tool-calling review records a recent decision about the same provider boundary and the acceptable scope of compatibility behavior.
